# Keep TX Red

> Independent Texas political news, election coverage, legislative tracking, government accountability, statewide reporting, and civic resources.

Keep TX Red covers Texas politics, elections, public officials, the Legislature, bills, state agencies, government accountability, major statewide developments, business, sports, and the policy debates affecting Texans. Nonpolitical lifestyle, relocation, travel, property-tax planning, and household calculators are owned by TexasDefined.com.

## News & Coverage

- [Latest News](/news): Current Texas reporting and analysis.
- [Texas Politics](/texas-politics): State political coverage and policy analysis.
- [Happening Now](/happening-now): Fast-moving Texas developments.
- [Texas Business](/texas-business): Business, regulation, energy, and economic policy.
- [Texas Sports](/texas-sports): Texas professional and statewide sports coverage.

## Elections & Government

- [Election Central](/elections/2026): Texas races, candidates, polling, forecasts, voting information, and results.
- [County Elections](/county-elections): County-level election resources.
- [Candidate Guides](/candidate-guides): Plain-language candidate and race guides.
- [Texas Legislature](/texas-legislature): Chambers, sessions, committees, and lawmakers.
- [Bills](/bills): Texas legislation, actions, sponsors, and documents.
- [Legislative Updates](/legislative-updates): Legislative reporting and analysis.
